agent.problem: The retelling of 8:19 stops at administering the offering to honor the Lord and omits the other stated purpose: to show Paul's team's eagerness to help. No later card covers that purpose, leaving out one of the verse's two parallel purposes.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
